info.name: HustleHub Part 2 - Secure Marketplace API
info.description:
Part 2 Postman collection for the HustleHub+ secure MERN marketplace.

Run the folders in order (or run the whole collection with Newman). It registers fresh users each run, then tests the full flow: authentication -> gig creation -> booking -> transaction -> income, plus RBAC, ownership, validation/sanitisation, rate-limit headers and security headers.

Authentication uses an HttpOnly JWT cookie, which Postman/Newman store and send automatically.

Prerequisites: backend running on https://localhost:5000 and the database seeded (for the Admin account).

item.name: 0. Health & Security Headers
item.description: Confirms the API is served over HTTPS and that Helmet/CSP headers are applied.
